Read `README.md` and current rollout evidence first. Produce exactly one multi-wake target-policy candidate in `solver/`. Keep candidate-specific reasoning in `logs/optimize/wake_policy_notes.md`, and add or materially revise at least one evidence-backed reusable lesson in `guidance/control_experience.md` from the assigned parent, sampled solver results, and inherited logs. If no positive lesson survives the evidence, record a concrete negative result and what later workers should avoid or test. The candidate is incomplete until both files are updated. Work only inside this Phase 2 workspace.

This is the no-Bookshelf ablation: no cross-domain fish-control research shelf
is provided. Base controller proposals only on the task contract, current and
inherited guidance, sampled solver results, inherited optimizer logs, and
current rollout evidence. Do not search for or reconstruct the omitted shelf
from neighboring configurations or repository history.

I’ll first read the workspace contract and the wake-visual inspection skill, then inspect the current rollout evidence before touching the target policy. I’ll keep all work inside this Phase 2 workspace and won’t consult neighboring runs, history, or any omitted research shelf.

The visual-first skill applies here because the sampled solvers include wake keyframe sheets. It requires comparing the best finite result with the most informative failure, checking both against metrics and diagnostics, and writing the diagnosis before editing the policy; I’m following that sequence now.

The current sampled rollout set contains four finite target reaches and no failure keyframe sheet. I’m therefore using the inherited unstable result only as a documented safety boundary, while making the visual comparison on the strongest current finite rollouts (fastest/lowest-load versus highest scalar score). I won’t invent missing failure visuals or diagnostics.

The strongest new evidence is a clean one-parameter boundary: the assigned parent’s global guard increase `28→29` preserved capture but worsened arrival (`74.23→80.00`), mean distance (`2.561→2.658L`), upstream-relative speed (`0.0643→0.0580`), and loads (`22.39/393→33.84/489`). The sampled posterior-only reduction `28→27` improved the scalar score and mean distance slightly, but slowed capture and raised loads, so I’m checking the exact score and observation contract before selecting a bounded follow-up rather than extrapolating blindly.

I’ve selected one conservative follow-up: retain the proven anterior gait and steering, split the soft guards, and set only the posterior guard to `27.5 rad/time²`. This brackets two finite evaluations: `28` is faster/lower-load, while `27` has the better score and slightly lower mean distance. I’m recording that falsifiable diagnosis in the required notes before editing the candidate, as the visual-first skill requires.

The single candidate and both required evidence files are now updated. The durable lesson records the assigned parent’s `29`-guard regression and the sampled posterior-`27` mixed result, with an explicit held-out falsification boundary. I’m moving to the mandated checker and contract validation; I will not run CFD.

The guidance checker passes. The mandated Julia contract command is currently blocked because `julia` is not on this environment’s `PATH` (the policy itself has not failed). I’m checking for the workspace’s pinned Julia wrapper/binary and will rerun the exact contract check if available; the remaining static schema and boundary checks continue meanwhile.

The guidance and boundary checks pass, and the deterministic parameter-schema guard also passes. There is no Julia executable in the workspace or the environment’s standard/pinned locations, so I’m doing one last check for an available module/container runtime before reporting that single environment limitation; no CFD is being launched.

Completed one candidate:

- [candidate_target_policy.jl](solver/cases/dogfish_2d_shape_policy/candidate_target_policy.jl:1): posterior-only `27.5 rad/time²` guard probe.
- [wake_policy_notes.md](logs/optimize/wake_policy_notes.md:1): visual diagnosis and falsifiable hypothesis.
- [control_experience.md](guidance/control_experience.md:107): reusable acceleration-guard lesson.

Guidance and boundary checks pass; static parameter-schema validation passes. The Julia execution subcheck could not run because no local Julia channel is installed and the available launcher’s download failed. No CFD was run.
